launchEvents.event: TokenLaunched(address indexed token, address indexed deployer, address indexed dexFactory, address pairToken, address pool, uint256 dexId, uint256 launchConfigId, uint256 positionId, uint256 restrictionsEndBlock, uint256 initialBuyAmount)
launchEvents.metadataHow: After TokenLaunched, eth_call token.name(), symbol(), logo(), description(), socials()

launchEvents.event: TokenDeployed(address indexed token, address indexed deployer, address indexed dexFactory, address pairToken, uint256 dexId, uint256 launchConfigId)
launchEvents.notes: Optional pre-launch deploy step; prefer TokenLaunched for completed pairs.

launchEvents.event: V4TokenLaunched(address indexed token, address indexed creator, bytes32 indexed poolId, uint256 ethSeeded, uint256 tokensSeeded)
launchEvents.metadataHow: After V4TokenLaunched, eth_call PeepsV4Token name/symbol/logo/description/socials; store poolId for PoolManager.Swap

launchEvents.event: TokenCreated(address indexed token, address indexed curve, address indexed creator, string name, string symbol, bytes32 metadataHash, string metadataUri, address pool, uint8 graduationCap, uint16 postGradCreatorShareBps)
launchEvents.metadataHow: name + symbol + metadataUri + metadataHash are ON the event. Resolve metadataUri (data: JSON, ipfs://, or https) for image/description/socials.

launchEvents.event: TokenCreated(address indexed token, address indexed curve, address indexed creator, string name, string symbol, bytes32 metadataHash, string metadataUri, address pool, uint8 graduationCap, uint16 postGradCreatorShareBps)
launchEvents.metadataHow: Same TokenCreated ABI as Bonding V3.

graduationEvents.event: Graduated(address indexed token, address indexed pool, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 wethInPosition, uint256 tokensInPosition, uint256 graduationFee, address caller, uint256 callerReward, uint256 tokensBurned, uint256 wethDustToTreasury)

Graduated(address indexed token, bytes32 indexed poolId, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 wethInPosition, uint256 tokensInPosition, uint256 graduationFee, address caller, uint256 callerReward, uint256 tokensBurned, uint256 wethDustToTreasury)

tradeEvents.event: Trade(address indexed trader, bool indexed isBuy, uint256 ethAmount, uint256 tokenAmount, uint256 fee, uint256 virtualEthReserves, uint256 virtualTokenReserves, uint256 realEthReserves)
tradeEvents.notes: Emitted on each per-token PeepsBondingCurve (CREATE2). See abis/shared/PeepsBondingCurve.abi.json.

tradeEvents.event: GraduatedSwap(address indexed token, address indexed trader, bool isBuy, uint256 ethAmount, uint256 tokenAmount, uint256 platformFee)
tradeEvents.notes: Swap fill through Peeps V4 router — not a launch event.

instantGraduationNote: Instant V3/V4 do NOT emit a migrator Graduated event. Soft graduation is view-only via factory.graduationStatus(token) (paired WETH vs ~4.2 ETH threshold). Liquidity is locked from block 0.
